title: Search ranks out-of-stock items first
description: Customers complained that the first results for popular queries were sold out.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Root cause: the ranking boost read a stock snapshot that is only refreshed nightly, so items that sold out during the day kept their boost.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Fixed by filtering on a live in_stock flag that the inventory service updates within seconds, and keeping popularity only as a tie-breaker.

comments.author: Marcus Lee
comments.body: Considered refreshing the snapshot hourly but rejected it because customers would still see sold-out items for up to an hour.
